games.title: Next Stop: Bus Traffic Jam
games.tagline: Tap the buses, clear the traffic jam and get every rider aboard by color!
games.intro: The buses are stuck, the crowd is waiting, and only you can get everyone moving through a sunny toy town.
how: Tap a bus and it drives the way its arrow points.
It parks in a free bay beside the crowd.
Riders of the same color hop aboard.
A full bus drives off and frees its bay.
Send every bus on its way to win the level.
highlights: Boosters: Crowd Shuffle, Balloon and Bus Shuffle
The Balloon lifts any bus straight to the gold Express Bay
Hidden buses keep their color secret until the moment is right
Win and your bus drives on through town to the next stop
Glossy toy buses, cheerful riders, flower beds and little houses

games.title: Bubble Word Sort: Word Puzzle
games.tagline: Drag words into bubbles, match the ones that belong together and reveal groups!
games.intro: Every bubble holds a word, and every word belongs to a hidden group. Find the words that go together in a sunny underwater lagoon.
how: Drag a bubble onto another word from the same group.
The two bubbles merge into a bigger one that keeps both words.
Add the rest of the group and the bubble turns gold.
The gold bubble pops and reveals the name of the group.
Clear every group on the board to win the level.
highlights: Some words fit more than one idea, so look closely before you drop
A streak of right drops earns an extra move
Hint lights up two words that belong together
Magnet pulls a whole group together
A living lagoon of fish, a friendly turtle and a jellyfish
games.money: Free to play. Contains ads and optional in-app purchases, including Remove Ads (optional reward videos stay available).

games.title: Color Stack Sort Master
games.tagline: Drop, stack and sort the candy tiles until every stack is one bright color!
games.intro: Every level is a row of stacks full of glossy candy tiles, and one tile is waiting in your hand.
how: Tap a stack to drop your tile on top.
The tile at the bottom of that stack pops out into your hand.
A full stack of one color is complete and locks with a check mark.
Complete every stack before your moves run out.
highlights: Rainbow tiles never count toward a color, so move them along
Secret tiles hide their color until they reach the bottom of a stack
Boosters: Undo, Swap and Magic Sort
Jelly-soft tiles that bounce, hop and settle with crisp sounds
games.money: Free to play. Contains ads and optional in-app purchases, including coin packs, booster bundles and No Ads (optional reward videos stay available).

games.title: Rainbow Sand: Color Sort
games.tagline: Sort the colorful sand into buckets and bring bright pixel pictures to life!
games.intro: Every level is a pixel picture made of colorful sand, and a tray of buckets is waiting to collect it.
how: Tap a bucket to send it onto the conveyor belt.
As it rides the belt, it draws its own color of sand out of the picture.
A full bucket leaves the belt and makes room for the next one.
The belt only has a few slots, so choose the order well.
Collect all the sand to clear the picture.
highlights: Mystery buckets keep their color secret until you reach them
Boosters: Extra Slot, Clear, Magnet and Shuffle
Tap the x2 tag to make the belt run twice as fast
Soft sand sounds, with every grain flowing into the buckets
Coins for every picture and a daily gift
games.money: Free to play. Contains ads and optional in-app purchases, including Remove Ads (optional reward videos stay available).

games.title: Rocket Kingdoms: Castle Siege
games.tagline: Aim, fire and blast rival castles! Build a fortress and lead a crew of heroes.
games.intro: Pull back, aim and fire. Your crew shoots from inside your castle, and every hit blows the enemy's walls apart, brick by brick, until their crew is knocked out.
how: Drag back to set the power and the angle, then let go to fire.
Take turns with your rival and knock out their crew to win.
Every castle is built differently: find its weak spot and bring it down.
highlights: A crew of heroes with weapons of their own: rockets, bomb volleys, piercing bolts, powder kegs, bee hives and frost stones
Add rooms, upgrade blocks from timber to stone and iron, and fit shields, nets and cannons
Climb the leagues and beat each league's king at his own gate
Fight across waterfall valleys, cherry blossom hills, desert sands, snowy villages, royal palaces and a volcano
Win crates and cards, then earn more on the Siege Pass, the daily decrees and the weekend Boss Rush
games.note: Battles are against computer opponents, so you can play at your own pace.
games.money: Free to play. Contains ads and optional in-app purchases.

games.title: Gemlings: Block Puzzle
games.tagline: Fit glowing gems, clear lines and team up with cute crystal Gemlings!
games.intro: Restore the shattered Heartstone of Glimmerdeep, one gleaming line at a time, with crystal creatures who charge up as you play.
how: Drag glowing gem blocks onto the 8×8 board.
Fill rows and columns to clear them, and chain clears for big combos.
Charge up your Gemlings and unleash their powers.
highlights: Hatch eggs and collect 12 Gemlings, from Common to Legendary
60 Adventure levels across five magical regions
Relaxing Classic mode with no timer
8 power-ups, from Hammer and Bomb to Prism and Undo
Daily Challenge, quests, a 7-day gift streak and the Fortune Wheel
Plays offline, no internet needed
games.money: Free to play with optional in-app purchases and ads. Remove Ads available.

games.title: Ant Colony: Sort Puzzle
games.tagline: Send out cute ants, sort colorful cubes and clear every pixel picture!
games.intro: Every level is a picture made of glossy color cubes, and a busy colony of cute ants is ready to carry it away, cube by cube.
how: Tap a box of ants to move it into a slot.
Its ants march onto the picture, pick up cubes of their own color and carry them home.
Ants can only reach cubes they can walk to, so choose which box to send next.
If every slot fills up, the level is lost, so plan ahead.
highlights: Pixel pictures of hot-air balloons, rockets, parrots, pumpkins and cupcakes
Boosters: Extra Slot, Shuffle, Pick Up and Tornado
2x speed whenever you like
Coins, a daily reward and costumes to unlock for your ant
games.money: Free to play. Contains ads and optional in-app purchases, including No Ads (optional reward videos stay available).

games.title: Cube Arrows: Logic Puzzle
games.tagline: Tap the arrows off the 3D cube, plan every move and clear the puzzle!
games.intro: Every level is a cube or a block shape covered in arrows, and every arrow wants out.
how: Tap an arrow and it slides along its path, folds over the edges and leaves the shape.
If it runs into another arrow, it springs back and you lose a heart.
Swipe to turn the shape and pinch to zoom.
Find the right order and clear every arrow to win.
highlights: Boosters: Hint, Eraser, Hammer and Power Arrow
A free grid shows where every arrow will go
Light and dark themes
Coins for every cleared level
games.money: Free to play. Contains ads and optional in-app purchases, including Remove Ads (optional reward videos stay available).

games.title: Boom Tower Smash: Cannon Game
games.tagline: Aim, fire and enjoy a satisfying smash in this physics puzzle cannon game!
games.intro: Welcome to the seaside fair, where every stall has a tower waiting for your cannon. Tin cans clatter, jam jars splash, wooden crates splinter and stone blocks tumble.
how: Tap to aim and fire the cannon.
Knock every prop off the stand before your shots run out.
Use boosters when a tower needs a little extra power.
highlights: 1,285 levels, from easy warm-ups to tricky towers
7 fairground worlds, from Meadow Fair to Candy Fair
Real physics: every hit, topple and chain reaction plays out differently
Boosters: the giant Hammer, Multi-Strike, Mega Cannon and Infinite Cannon
Up to 3 stars per level, and coins to collect
games.money: Free to play with optional in-app purchases and ads. Remove Ads available.

games.title: Marble Flow: Color Sort 3D
games.tagline: Sort colorful marbles, match the right colors, and clear challenging levels!
games.intro: Watch colorful marbles roll along moving paths, make your choices and solve increasingly tricky logic puzzles in a vibrant 3D world.
how: Tap to release colorful marbles into the flow.
Sort marbles into matching color containers.
Complete collection goals and clear each level.
Keep the flow moving and avoid overcrowding.
highlights: Hundreds of sorting puzzle levels
Smooth 3D visuals and realistic marble movement
Helpful boosters for difficult moments
Plays offline, anytime and anywhere

games.title: Screwdom City: Fun Puzzle 3D
games.tagline: Match colorful screws in a relaxing and addictive puzzle adventure!
games.intro: Sort colorful screws, organize them by color and complete satisfying puzzle levels in a fun 3D world.
how: Move screws between pins.
Group the matching colors together.
Think ahead and use the available space wisely.
highlights: A large collection of handcrafted levels
New obstacles and layouts keep every level fresh
Simple tap-and-play controls
Colorful 3D graphics and smooth animations
games.money: Free to play. Contains ads and optional in-app purchases.

games.title: Color Arrow Escape Puzzle
games.tagline: Clear arrows, solve tricky puzzles, and master every challenging level!
games.intro: Tap and clear arrows in the correct order, unlock blocked paths and solve puzzles that test your thinking.
how: Tap arrows to move them in their indicated direction.
Only arrows with a clear path can be removed.
Plan your moves carefully.
Clear all arrows to complete the level.
highlights: Hundreds of logic levels
New mechanics as the challenge grows
Smooth controls and satisfying animations
Easy to learn, difficult to master

games.title: Indian Truck Simulator Games
games.tagline: Drive heavy trucks on offroad uphill tracks.
games.intro: Start the engine, fill your oil tanker at the refinery and haul it to the station, or carry logs across hilly offroad tracks.
highlights: Oil tankers, log trucks and trailers to drive
Offroad hills, zig-zag tracks, mud and city routes
Transport missions from the refinery to the gas station
Plays offline

games.title: Formula Racing Game 3D
games.tagline: Formula cars, championship races and ramp stunts.
games.intro: Take a formula car onto the track, race for the championship, or send it flying up the ramps on stunt tracks.
highlights: Multiple formula cars to choose from
Championship levels and several race modes
Ramp stunts on impossible tracks
Racing pits and a windscreen view
games.money: Free to play. Contains ads and optional in-app purchases.

games.title: Car Race Game 3D
games.tagline: Street races, car upgrades and police chases.
games.intro: Pick a car, race through traffic and upgrade your ride in the garage.
highlights: Police car chase mode
Upgrade engines, nitro and gears
Customize your car with paint and decals
Tilt or touch steering, with manual or automatic acceleration
Multiple camera views
